KG_TRANSPORT.description: Transport mechanism for the server (e.g., streamable-http).

servers.name: kg-mcp

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to interact with the Pipedrive CRM to manage deals, contacts, organizations, and activities. It features automatic custom field synchronization and guided onboarding to ensure assistants follow specific business rules and pipelines.

PIPEDRIVE_API_KEY.description: Seu token pessoal da API do Pipedrive (Pipedrive > Configurações > Dados pessoais > API).

servers.name: Pipedrive MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server for tracking and managing AI command usage history using a PostgreSQL database. It enables users to log, search, and view statistics for various AI-related commands and their execution contexts.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL DSN for the database connection.

servers.name: mcp-commands

servers.description: Enables users to check crypto protocol risk ratings, search for DeFi protocols, and compare safety profiles using Hindenrank data. It provides detailed risk grades, top risks, and protocol verdicts directly through MCP-compatible clients.

HINDENRANK_API_KEY.description: API key for higher rate limits and more data

servers.name: Hindenrank MCP Server

servers.description: Enables AI agents to participate in a marketplace for buying, selling, and trading services with atomic escrow and cryptographic verification. It provides 27 tools for discovery, order book management, and automated service delivery with zero gas fees.

THEAGORA_API_KEY.description: Your Theagora API key (starts with agora_live_)

servers.name: Theagora MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server for managing Shelv shelf operations, enabling users to list, search, and read files within shelves. It also supports optional write functionalities for creating and hydrating shelves through configured tools.

SHELV_API_KEY.description: API key for Shelv shelf operations. Required for stdio mode or as a fallback in HTTP mode.

SHELV_MCP_HTTP_HOST.description: The host address to bind for HTTP transport. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

SHELV_MCP_HTTP_PORT.description: The port to bind for HTTP transport. Defaults to 3334.

SHELV_MCP_TRANSPORT.description: MCP transport protocol to use (stdio or http). Defaults to stdio.

SHELV_MCP_READ_MAX_BYTES.description: The maximum number of bytes to read from a single file. Defaults to 250000.

SHELV_MCP_SEARCH_MAX_BYTES.description: The maximum number of total bytes for a search operation. Defaults to 5000000.

SHELV_MCP_SEARCH_MAX_FILES.description: The maximum number of files to include in a search. Defaults to 500.

SHELV_MCP_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS.description: Set to 'true' to enable tools like create_shelf and hydrate_shelf.

SHELV_MCP_SEARCH_MAX_MATCHES.description: The maximum number of matches to return in a search. Defaults to 200.

servers.name: Shelv MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI agents to create instant public HTTPS URLs via Cloudflare Tunnels on mycrab.space. It provides tools for checking subdomain availability, setting up temporary tunnels, and managing permanent subdomains using Solana payments.
servers.name: mycrab-mcp

servers.description: Provides access to SEC EDGAR financial data, enabling AI agents to fetch company filings, financial metrics, and narrative sections. It supports natural-language metric searching and extracts structured data from 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K reports.

EDGAR_API_KEY.description: API key for EDGAR Financial API

EDGAR_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Path for output="file" responses. Falls back to ~/.cache/edgar-mcp/file_output if default is unavailable.

servers.name: edgar-mcp

servers.description: Provides cross-chain bridge and swap tools for AI agents using the Relay Protocol to interact with multiple blockchain networks. It enables agents to query supported chains, obtain transaction quotes, and generate unsigned transaction data for token transfers and swaps.

RELAY_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits

servers.name: Relay MCP Server

servers.description: Provides tools for interacting with Interactive Brokers Gateway to access market data, account summaries, and portfolio positions. It enables users to perform contract lookups, retrieve historical OHLCV bars, and view real-time quotes through natural language interfaces.
servers.name: Interactive Brokers MCP Server

servers.description: Provides a coherent memory layer for LLM agents that models beliefs as nodes in a constraint network to detect and surface semantic contradictions. It uses local embeddings and a hybrid geometric-logical energy model to identify conflicting information that requires review.

SEM_DATA_DIR.description: Directory where beliefs are stored. By default, beliefs are stored in .sem-data/memory-index.jsonl.

servers.name: Semantic Mesh Memory (SEM) MCP Server

servers.description: A minimalist indexing tool that provides AI agents with semantic search and structural AST parsing for deep codebase understanding. It enables autonomous agents to navigate large codebases predictably using vector embeddings and native language server capabilities like definition and reference tracking.

PORT.description: The port to run the indexer on for SSE/HTTP mode

API_KEY.description: Bearer token for security when running in SSE/HTTP mode

CODEBASE_PATH.description: Absolute path to the codebase to be indexed

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Gemini API Key for semantic embeddings

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API Key for semantic embeddings

VOYAGE_API_KEY.description: Voyage API Key for semantic embeddings

servers.name: Headless Codebase Indexer

servers.description: A local-first security system for autonomous AI agents that provides tools for security verification, goal anchoring, and action logging. It protects against prompt injection and goal drift by enforcing user-defined rules and offering performance insights through session grading.
servers.name: Carapace MCP Server

servers.description: A Kali Linux-based MCP server that exposes over 45 penetration testing tools for AI-assisted security auditing and vulnerability scanning. It features strict scope enforcement, structured output parsing, and persistent finding storage to automate the offensive security workflow.

DB_PATH.description: Path to SQLite database for persistence (default is ~/.arsenal/arsenal.db)

TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for tool execution in seconds (default is 300)

WORDLIST.description: Path to wordlist for tools like dirb (default is /usr/share/wordlists/dirb/common.txt)

PLUGIN_DIR.description: Directory containing custom tool plugins (default is ~/.arsenal/plugins)

servers.name: Arsenal MCP

servers.description: Connects MCP tools to the Zappaz WhatsApp API, enabling agents to send and manage multimedia messages, contacts, and locations. It supports automated WhatsApp interactions including text, audio, video, and document delivery via a remote server.

sessionId.description: The session ID for the WhatsApp session, required in the URL query string (e.g., ?sessionId=YOUR_SESSION).

Authorization.description: The session token required in the Authorization header.

servers.name: Zappaz MCP Server

servers.description: Provides advanced image analysis capabilities including object recognition, OCR text extraction, and multi-turn visual dialogues using OpenAI-compatible APIs. It supports both local files and Base64 inputs with additional features for session persistence and web-based configuration management.
servers.name: MCP Vision Server
